gate.kill_criterion: Variance reduction must come out BETTER than the reference while the reclaim stream still visibly drifts. A number that improves while the problem gets worse is the point; if the number does not improve, the trend is not reaching the input.

reason: Variance reduction is measured against the input variance, and a trend inflates that denominator without being the kind of variability blending can address. It is the standard way the metric flatters a bed, and the product should show it rather than avoid it.

summary.en: Grade drifts steadily from the first bench to the last, which is what a dig sequence through a zoned ore body produces. A drift is not noise: no amount of mixing removes it.
summary.es: La ley deriva de forma sostenida desde el primer banco hasta el ultimo, que es lo que produce una secuencia a traves de un cuerpo zonificado. Una deriva no es ruido: ninguna mezcla la elimina.

title.en: Trending feed, grade drifting through the campaign
title.es: Alimentacion con tendencia, ley que deriva durante la campana
